title: Linear cuts CI cost and delay as AI-generated code multiplies tests
friendlyTitle: Linear makes software checks faster as AI creates more code
summary: Linear says its test suite nearly quadrupled as agents accelerated software development, turning continuous integration into a bottleneck. Faster runners, a native TypeScript compiler, leaner checkout jobs and lower setup overhead cut runner time per test roughly in half while reducing pull-request waits.
friendlySummary: AI coding tools helped Linear produce many more tests, but checking every change became slow and expensive. The company improved its computers, tools and test setup to reduce waiting and cost.
whyItMatters: AI coding shifts the constraint from producing code to validating it. Engineering teams adopting agents should measure queue time, setup cost and critical-path jobs before simply adding more test shards or accepting a larger cloud bill.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI can write code faster than teams can check it. Companies should improve their testing system so speed does not reduce quality or create a much larger bill.
